title: Growing up
_map: Growing up (Y2). Big idea: animals have young that grow into adults; they need food, water and air. Creative: match babies to adults (lamb, chick, tadpole); which change the most?
_story: Spring on the farm: babies everywhere. Steve can't tell which baby belongs to which grown-up. Ismaeel matches them and finds the one that changes most: the tadpole becomes a frog.
_stepChain: living things make new living things (alive-or-not) → babies grow into adults → lamb to sheep, chick to hen → some look like their parents, some don't → tadpole to frog changes most → all need food, water and air

talk.ask: Which baby changes the most as it grows up?
talk.goodAnswer: the tadpole: it grows legs, loses its tail and becomes a frog.

talk.ask: What do all baby animals need to grow?

handsOn: Look at photos of yourself as a baby. What has changed? What has stayed the same? Then find pictures of a caterpillar and a butterfly.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: It's spring, and there are babies everywhere! Little chicks, woolly lambs, and wriggly things in the pond. Which baby grows into which grown-up?
A chick hatches from an egg, and grows into a hen. A lamb grows into a sheep. They look quite like their parents, only smaller.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: In the pond there are tiny black wriggly things with tails. They look like little fish. So they'll grow into big fish!

question.onRight: Yes. Tadpoles grow legs, lose their tails, and become frogs.

0.mistake: judged by how the baby looks now
0.hint: Some babies look very different from their parents. Which pond animal has a tail when it's young but not when it's grown?
0.say: Tadpoles look like fish at first, but they grow legs, lose their tails and hop out as frogs. They change more than any other farm baby.

2.hint: Ducklings hatch from eggs with feathers. Do tadpoles have feathers?
2.say: Ducks hatch as fluffy ducklings. Tadpoles grow legs and lose their tails to become frogs.

question.reveal: Tadpole, then froglet, then frog. The biggest change of all!

narration.text: Every baby animal needs the same things to grow: food, water, and air to breathe. And a grown-up to keep it safe.

rule.text: Babies grow into adults. Some change a lot.
rule.ask: Can you say which baby changes the most as it grows? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Animals have babies that grow into adults. Some look like their parents, and some, like tadpoles, change a lot. All of them need food, water and air.

bonus.reveal: A butterfly! It wraps itself up and comes out completely changed.
